thag4.3:1.1: Pare ca na vijānanti mayam ettha yamāmase; ye ca tattha vijānanti, tato sammanti medhagā. || ||
thag4.3:2.1: yadā ca avijānantā iriyanty amarā viyā, vijānanti ca ye dhammaṃ āturesu anāturā. || ||
thag4.3:3.1: yaṃ kiñci sithilaṃ kammaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhañ ca yaṃ vataṃ saṃkassaraṃ brahmacariyaṃ, na taṃ hoti mahapphalaṃ. || ||
thag4.3:4.1: yassa sabrahmacārīsu gāravo n' ūpalabbhati, ārakā hoti saddhammā nabhaṃ puthaviyā yathā 'ti. || || Sabhiyo thero.
